Variants.Content: Longships have long and narrow hulls and shallow drafts, and can be propelled by sails and oars. They are suitable for fast navigation, landing and evacuation on the Iron Islands and the northern coast. It could not carry as much cargo as a broad-bellied merchant ship, but it could sail into shoals and river mouths; its crew was both oarsmen and warriors.
